name: Kazama Windows RDP
author: kazamaofficial-git@users.noreply.github.com
description: Windows Server (2025 / 2022) over RDP, packaged by Kazama. Connect with Windows App. Optional private access over Tailscale, Storage Booster and performance tuning. NOT a VPS. Requires a Wings node that lets the container run as root with a writable root filesystem, and a Mount at /storage - see pterodactyl/README.md. Without KVM it runs on software emulation (very slow).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# ============================================================
# Kazama Windows - Pterodactyl installation script
# Developer  : @kazamaofficial-git
# Repository : https://github.com/kazamaofficial-git/kazama-windows
# ============================================================
# Runs once in the installer container (as root). It only prepares the server
# folder: Windows itself is downloaded and installed by the image on first start.
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/storage

cat > /mnt/server/README-KAZAMA.txt <<'EOT'
Kazama Windows RDP  -  by @kazamaofficial-git
https://github.com/kazamaofficial-git/kazama-windows

1. Windows is downloaded and installed on the FIRST start. Watch the console.
   Without KVM this can take hours.
2. Persistent data: attach a Mount with target /storage (see pterodactyl/README.md).
   Without it, Windows is re-installed on every container re-creation.
3. Connect with "Windows App": PC name = <node-ip>:<port of allocation mapped to 3389>
   Username = RDP_USERNAME, password = RDP_PASSWORD.
4. RDP_PASSWORD / RDP_USERNAME / WINDOWS_VERSION apply only at the first install.
EOT

echo "Kazama Windows: server folder prepared."

variables.name: RDP password (required)
variables.description: Password of the Windows user. 8+ characters, mix 3 of: lowercase, UPPERCASE, digits, symbols; no spaces or < > & " '; must not contain the username. Applied at the first install only.

variables.name: RDP username
variables.description: Administrator account created at the first install (letters, digits, _ or -, max 20, starts with a letter).

variables.name: Windows version
variables.description: windows-latest (Server 2025), windows-2025 or windows-2022. Applied at the first install only - wipe /storage to change later.

variables.name: VM RAM
variables.description: RAM given to Windows, e.g. 4G or 8G. Must fit inside the server's memory limit.

variables.name: VM CPU cores
variables.description: Number of vCPU cores given to Windows.

variables.name: VM disk size
variables.description: Virtual disk size, e.g. 40G. Must fit in the /storage mount.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Log language: en (English) or id (Bahasa Indonesia).

variables.name: Tailscale auth key (optional)
variables.description: Reusable + ephemeral Tailscale auth key. When set, RDP is reachable privately over your tailnet and no public port is needed.

variables.name: Tailscale machine name
variables.description: Machine name shown in your Tailscale admin.

variables.name: Storage Booster mode
variables.description: Inside Windows: off, safe (caches), deep (+ hibernation, shadow copies, Windows.old, installer cache) or max (+ removes Edge, Firefox, Unity, R, Haskell, Android, Visual Studio... Chrome is kept). Applied at the first install.

variables.name: Storage Booster schedule
variables.description: Automatic Storage Booster run inside Windows: off, daily or weekly (03:00).

variables.name: Booster: apps to keep
variables.description: Comma separated catalog ids that mode max must NOT remove, e.g. chrome,visualstudio.

variables.name: Kazama wallpaper
variables.description: Apply the Kazama wallpaper on each user's first logon (true / false).

variables.name: Performance tuning
variables.description: Tuning inside Windows for software emulation: off, light (Server Manager, indexing, telemetry, maintenance off) or max (also Defender real-time and Windows Update off).
